_comment: Source registry - same role as constraint-archaeology-agents/config/sources.json, read by whoever performs the external capture step (this package's own code never fetches these). Deliberately empty: this session has no verified, specific regulatory/permit/accreditation/infrastructure/environmental-rights/demand-shock source URLs to record, and fabricating one would misrepresent an unverified claim as a real source (CLAUDE.md: 'Provenance is truthful or absent'). A human with real domain knowledge of the target jurisdiction/sector must populate `sources` before capture begins. Every entry's `category` must be one of the six values in `categories` below - this is the single registry the six research-doc 'hunter' roles collapse into (see approved architecture review, section 5).
